name: Rice
yields: About 2 large servings per ½ cup uncooked rice
notes: Adjust quantities for number to be served—about two large servings per ½ cup uncooked rice.

steps.title: Boil the water
steps.body: Bring to a boil in a pot with a lid: **1 cup water** and **¼ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Simmer the rice
steps.body: Add **½ cup rice**. Cover, and simmer (lowest setting) for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Check and fluff
steps.body: When the rice surface is “pocked,” rice is ready to serve. Fluff with a fork.
